decision.reason: MKT-READ-001 reads restored legacy tables and must not create or alter schema.
decision.global_rule: Never run php artisan migrate against a restored legacy database without an approved registry row and a recorded precondition result.

entries.precondition_sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'jl_staging_restore_20261030' AND TABLE_NAME IN ('users','password_reset_tokens','sessions');
entries.precondition_result: users exists with legacy columns; password_reset_tokens and sessions are absent
entries.post_check_sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'jl_staging_restore_20261030' AND TABLE_NAME IN ('users','password_reset_tokens','sessions');
entries.rollback: Do not run down() on the restored legacy target; it would drop the legacy users table. Use a disposable database rebuild instead.
entries.collision_policy: Hold permanently for the legacy target. Use legacy auth adapter and separate Laravel-owned database if native auth tables are later required.

entries.scope: Laravel database cache and cache locks
entries.precondition_sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'jl_staging_restore_20261030' AND TABLE_NAME IN ('cache','cache_locks');
entries.precondition_result: both tables absent; current read-only staging uses file cache
entries.post_check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cache_table_count FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'jl_staging_restore_20261030' AND TABLE_NAME IN ('cache','cache_locks');
entries.rollback: Only on a disposable database after confirming no application cache data is needed; never drop shared legacy tables.
entries.collision_policy: Do not run for MKT-READ-001. Re-open only when database cache is explicitly selected and the target owner is recorded.

entries.scope: Laravel database queue, batches, and failed jobs
entries.precondition_sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'jl_staging_restore_20261030' AND TABLE_NAME IN ('jobs','job_batches','failed_jobs');
entries.precondition_result: all three tables absent; no worker is attached to the restored database
entries.post_check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS queue_table_count FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'jl_staging_restore_20261030' AND TABLE_NAME IN ('jobs','job_batches','failed_jobs');
entries.rollback: Only after worker shutdown and queue drain review; preserve failed-job evidence before any disposable-target rebuild.
entries.collision_policy: Do not run for read-only pilots. Re-open only under G6 with scheduler disabled, one-worker proof, and queue ownership approval.

entries.scope: Adds company_key, scopes module, and replaces global unique idempotency key
entries.precondition_sql: SELECT COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'jl_staging_restore_20261030' AND TABLE_NAME = 'idempotency_keys' AND COLUMN_NAME IN ('company_key','module'); SELECT INDEX_NAME,NON_UNIQUE,COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'jl_staging_restore_20261030' AND TABLE_NAME = 'idempotency_keys';
entries.precondition_result: company_key absent; module present; global unique index on idempotency_key present; zero rows currently stored
entries.post_check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS missing_scope_rows FROM jl_staging_restore_20261030.idempotency_keys WHERE company_key IS NULL OR company_key = '' OR module IS NULL OR module = ''; SELECT INDEX_NAME,NON_UNIQUE,COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'jl_staging_restore_20261030' AND TABLE_NAME = 'idempotency_keys' AND INDEX_NAME = 'uq_idempotency_scope';
entries.rollback: Migration down() must refuse rollback if duplicate idempotency_key values exist after scoping. Rehearse on a disposable copy before any staging write.
entries.collision_policy: Never assign legacy rows to a real company automatically. Use LEGACY-GLOBAL/legacy only after explicit write-gate approval; reject any post-scope duplicate before applying the unique index.
